New York's new trend uploading- Fusion & Bollywood Garba on a Rooftop, followed by a Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty

About this Event

🎉 GARBA X BOLLYWOOD@ 230 FIFTH ROOFTOP
Forget everything you know about Garba. Lets set a new trend in New York- where tradition meets Bollywood.
Get ready for NYC's most exciting Navratri celebration—a spectacular Fusion of Traditional & Bollywood Garba experience set against a breathtaking lakeside backdrop.
THIS IS NOT YOUR TRADITIONAL GARBA. THIS IS WHERE YOU DRESS GARBA BUT DANCE BOLLYWOOD.
Feel the energy as our Desi DJs take the stage with an electrifying mix of traditional Garba rhythms, Bollywood favorites, and high-energy fusion beats that will keep you dancing all night long. From the first dhol beat to the final song, expect an atmosphere filled with celebration, culture, and unforgettable memories.
And when the Garba circles wind down... the party is just getting started.
🔥 Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty featuring DJ Browny — bringing the biggest Bollywood, dance, and party anthems to close out the night in style.

Your Night Includes✨ Live Fusion & Bollywood Garba 
🔥 Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty with DJ Browny
💃 Traditional Garba & Raas with a modern twist
🌅 A stunning Rooftop venue under the open sky
🍛 Delicious Indian food vendors
🛍️ Festive shopping, fashion, jewelry & cultural exhibitors
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 An unforgettable celebration for family and friends

Event Schedule
5:00 PM – 9 PM | Fusion & Bollywood Garba on the rooftop (21+ ONLY)
Celebrate Navratri with an energetic mix of traditional Garba rhythms and Bollywood favorites, with New York City views.
10:00 PM – 2:00 AM | Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty (21+ ONLY)
As the Garba winds down, the celebration turns into a full-scale Bollywood club night with DJ Browny spinning the biggest Bollywood dance hits.
Ticket Information
Your Garba ticket includes complimentary access to the Bollywood Dandiya Afterparty. Already have evening plans? Afterparty-only tickets are also available
